items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: The brass was Herman Franklin, Bill Matthews, and Kilby. ... when I was working with.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about different arranges. Did Herman Franklin ever do any arranging?

Well, Celestan, he had, uh, Hummer used to do a little arranging, Kildee used to do arranging. Somebody else up there. Then he used to buy, Caesar used to arrange for them too sometimes. Caesar, Cyclo, Clyclo. He used to have arranging for them. He used to buy arranging for different guys. Well, now we have to go over the Celestan band again. I think that was on the side of the tape. It didn't work. Who was the first trumpet with Celestan? The one, uh, was Herman Franklin that I remember when I was working with.…

That was in the thirties. When, and Mrs. Kimball was having a- Between thirty-five, between thirty-three and thirty-five. That's when you were traveling with the band? Yeah, I was traveling. Booking. You said you switched to the band. You said you switched to the band.
